items.text: Dịka mgbe m bụ nwata, mgbe Maman na-atọpụ eri akwa uwe ochie, anyị na-eburu eriri ahụ gburugburu ụlọ ka eri akwa ahụ ghara ịkpọkọta n'elu ibe ya.
items.q: Is it clear the children walk around inside the house, holding the yarn?

items.text: N'ime ụlọ nke dị na ngwụcha ogige ụlọ ahụ, n'akụkụ ekwu ọkụ, m tọgbọworo n'afọ m, nọ n'etiti uche ịchọta ụzọ mfe iji dozie ọtụtụ ajụjụ Konkoor ndị metụtara triigọnọmetrị site na iji cheekụl ọtụtụ ndị ahụ.
items.q: Is it clear Amir solves trigonometry problems using the unit circle?

items.text: Obi ụtọ maka ụzọ mfe na bara uru m chọtara, ebiliri m n'akụkụ ekwu ọkụ ahụ wee jiri urukurubụba mkpuchi akwụkwọ ahụ n'ahụ mgbidi, n'akụkụ ndụmọdụ Konkoor ndị ọzọ.
items.q: Is it clear Amir tapes the sheet to the wall beside his other notes?

items.text: Ọ na-emegharị nkwụ ọsọ ọsọ. Ọ na-awụ nkwụ karịrị akarị n'elu ihe ọtụtụ ahụ, wee were ụfọdụ laghachi.
items.q: The grocer is weighing chickpeas. Is 'nkwụ' the right word for chickpeas?

items.text: Ihe ọ bụla ọ zụrụ n'oge ahụ, echere m na ọ ga-aba ụba ugbu a ruo puku ugboro iri.
items.q: Does 'puku ugboro iri' clearly mean ten thousand times as much?

items.text: – Enyi nwa nwanne nna anyị nwoke, onye nwe ọka aka nke ọgọ nwoke anyị, onye bụ ọgaranya kachasị na Tehran, gwara ya banyere ya.
items.q: Does it clearly say: the friend of the cousin of our in-law's master craftsman?

items.text: Anwapụta na ọ bụrụ na m rụsie ọrụ n'aka ya ntakịrị, n'ihu unu ọ ga-ada azụ kwuo ka unu gaa n'ihu.
items.q: He bets the man would pull down his own trousers for them. Is that clear?

items.text: O ji ọsọ karịa ọsọ ìhè gbapụ, ma ọ bụghị, agaara m etikwasị ya ihe n'ike.
items.q: The speaker means he'd have hung him up by the backside. Is that clear?
